sections.title: Package description
sections.what: A one-line description that says the folder holds industry default assumptions.

summary: Package marker with a one-line description. It has no logic of its own.
purpose: Lets Python treat the defaults folder as a package that other files can import from.
why: Likely reason: Python needs this file to import from a folder.
risks: Deleting it can break imports from this folder.
debug: If an import from defaults fails, confirm this file still exists.
